$comment: Starter deck, v1. Written 2026-09-19 to be play-tested and rewritten. Mechanics are adapted from real on-course games: One Club, the String game, Gruesomes, Worst Ball, and the charity-scramble sabotage challenges (No Look Shot, Hold My Beer, Beat the Clock, No Tap-Ins). Every card is honour-system - the app records the play, the players enforce the rule. Edit these in the app rather than here once the card editor lands.

cards.title: Mulligan
cards.effect: Replay your last shot. The first one never happened — don't count it.
cards.notes: Must be played immediately, before anyone else hits.

cards.title: Reverse Mulligan
cards.effect: Make a player replay the shot they just hit. They must take the second one — even if it's worse.
cards.notes: Best saved for their one good drive of the day.

cards.title: Three's Company
cards.effect: Pick any three clubs from a player's bag. Those are the only clubs they may use for this entire hole.
cards.notes: You may include or exclude the putter. Choose cruelly.

cards.title: Caddie's Choice
cards.effect: You pick the club a player must use for their next shot. They have to hit it.

cards.title: Mirror
cards.effect: A card has just been played on you. Reflect it straight back — it now applies to the player who played it, exactly as written, and not to you.
cards.notes: Can be mirrored again by another Mirror. There is no limit. Good luck.

cards.title: Nice Try
cards.effect: Cancel a card just played on you. Nothing happens. Both cards are spent.

cards.title: No Look
cards.effect: A player must hit their next shot with their eyes fully closed. Someone else watches where it goes.

cards.title: Wrong Hand
cards.effect: A player must hit their next shot the wrong way round — a right-hander plays left-handed, and vice versa.
cards.notes: Flipping the club over is allowed. Being good at it is not.

cards.title: Hold My Beer
cards.effect: A player must hit their next shot one-handed, holding a full drink in the other hand. Spill it and add a stroke.

cards.title: Putter Off The Tee
cards.effect: A player must play their tee shot with the putter.
cards.notes: Devastating on a par 5. Merely rude on a par 3.

cards.title: Shot Swap
cards.effect: Swap balls with a player where they lie. You play their ball from its position, they play yours from yours. Strokes already taken stay with each player.
cards.notes: Play it right after they stripe one and you're in the trees.

cards.title: Commentator
cards.effect: You must loudly commentate a player's entire next shot in your best television voice, from address to landing. They may not ask you to stop.

cards.title: Army Golf
cards.effect: Left, right, left, right. Name a player: if they miss the fairway off the tee on this hole, they add one stroke. On a par 3, missing the green counts instead.

cards.title: Club Confiscation
cards.effect: Name one club in a player's bag. They may not use it for the next three holes.
cards.notes: Adapted from the old One Club game. Taking the driver is obvious; taking the putter is war.

cards.title: Gimme
cards.effect: Pick your ball up and count one putt — wherever it is on the green.
cards.notes: Must be on the putting surface. Fringe doesn't count.

cards.title: No Tap-Ins
cards.effect: Nothing is given on this green, for anybody. Every ball gets holed out, however short.

cards.title: Tee It Forward
cards.effect: Play your tee shot from up to fifty paces ahead of the markers.

cards.title: The String
cards.effect: Move your ball by up to one club length, no penalty, anywhere on the course. Out of a divot, around a tree, or into the hole if you're that close.
cards.notes: From the old String game. Yes, it works on the green.

cards.title: Beat the Clock
cards.effect: Everyone has six minutes from now to finish this hole. Anyone not holed out when time is up adds two strokes.
cards.notes: Someone start a timer. Playing this while you're away is a bold move.

cards.title: Everyone Swaps
cards.effect: Everybody plays their tee shot on this hole with a club borrowed from the player on their left.
cards.notes: The lender chooses which club they hand over.

cards.title: Wolf
cards.effect: You are the Wolf on this hole. After each player tees off you may claim them as your partner - but you must call it before the next player hits. Claim nobody and you play the hole alone against all of them.
cards.notes: From the Wolf game. The Wolf tees off last and decides on the walk.

cards.title: Skins
cards.effect: This hole is a skin. The lowest score outright takes it; if two or more players tie, nobody wins and the skin carries to the next hole. Keep carrying until somebody wins one outright.

cards.title: Snake
cards.effect: The snake is loose. The next player to three-putt is holding it, and keeps holding it until somebody else three-putts. Whoever is holding it when the round ends hears about it all the way to the car park.
cards.notes: Three putts from on the putting surface. The fringe does not count.

cards.title: Bingo Bango Bongo
cards.effect: Three points on this hole: one for the first ball on the green, one for the closest to the pin once everyone is on, and one for the first to hole out. Furthest from the hole always plays first.
cards.notes: Playing out of turn to steal a point forfeits that point.

cards.title: Shamble
cards.effect: Everybody tees off, then everybody picks up and plays their second shot from wherever the best drive finished. From there it is your own ball and your own score all the way in.

cards.title: Alternate Shot
cards.effect: Pair up for this hole. Each pair plays one ball, taking alternate shots, and both partners write down the same score. Decide who is teeing off before anybody hits.
cards.notes: Foursomes, properly. With three players it is one pair and one soloist.

cards.title: Aces and Deuces
cards.effect: On this hole the lowest score takes two points and the highest score gives one away. Ties cancel out - if two players share the low score, nobody takes anything at all.

cards.title: Longest Drive
cards.effect: Longest drive on this hole takes the honour on the next tee, whatever the scores say. It has to finish in play - a monster into the trees counts for nothing at all.

cards.title: Sandie
cards.effect: Get up and down from a bunker in two or fewer from the moment you are in the sand, and take one stroke off your score for this hole. Declare it before anybody writes anything down.

cards.title: Barkie
cards.effect: Hit a tree on this hole and still make par or better, and you take one stroke off your score. Declare it before anybody writes their score down.
cards.notes: Somebody else has to have heard the tree. No silent barkies.

cards.title: Arnie
cards.effect: Make par on this hole without ever once standing on the fairway, and take one stroke off your score. Named for Arnold Palmer, who made an entire career out of it.

cards.title: Ferret
cards.effect: Hole out from off the putting surface - a chip, a pitch, or a putt from the fringe - and take one stroke off your score for this hole.

cards.title: Golden Ferret
cards.effect: Hole out directly from a bunker and take two strokes off your score for this hole. If you had already been in a bunker earlier on the same hole, take three and enjoy yourself.

cards.title: The Stymie
cards.effect: Name a player. Your ball stays exactly where it lies on the green and they have to play around it, over it, or off it. They may not ask you to mark it until you have holed out.
cards.notes: The real rule of golf until 1952. It is the reason ball markers exist.

cards.title: Worst Ball
cards.effect: Name a player. From the tee on this hole they play two balls at every single shot, and must then carry on with the worse of the two, all the way into the hole.

cards.title: One Club Wonder
cards.effect: Name a player. They play this entire hole, tee to green, with a single club of their own choosing. They may pick the putter, and they will regret it either way.

cards.title: Flagstick In
cards.effect: Name a player. Every putt they hit on this green must be played with the flagstick left in the hole, and nobody is allowed to tend it for them.
cards.notes: Perfectly legal since 2019, which is exactly what makes it annoying.

cards.title: Play It As It Lies
cards.effect: Name a player. For the rest of this hole they get no preferred lies, no rolling it over, and no tapping anything down. Whatever the course gives them, they play.

cards.title: Provisional Required
cards.effect: Name a player before they tee off. They must declare and hit a provisional ball however good the first one looked, then play the hole out with whichever they choose.

cards.title: Rub of the Green
cards.effect: A card has just been played on you. Toss a tee in the air: if it points at you when it lands, the card stands as written. If it points anywhere else, the card is void and both are spent.
cards.notes: The fairest possible resolution, and completely unarguable.
